about.title: About Me
about.description: Senior Web Engineer with 5+ years experience building high-performance frontend architectures, AI-integrated workflows, and scalable e-commerce solutions using React, Node.js, and GraphQL.

responsibilities: Engineered AI-assisted onboarding, automating setup and significantly reducing merchant configuration time.
Architected a multi-location enterprise dashboard to streamline key metric tracking and account management.
Optimized onboarding conversion by resolving complex routing, state validation, and error-handling bottlenecks.
Elevated platform stability by building robust E2E and integration test suites for core and AI features.
Led zero-downtime React migration for a key configuration app, establishing a reusable component system.
Fortified financial processing by upgrading global payment flows and expanding E2E test coverage.
Modernized Node.js/React stacks and built self-serve payment tools, reducing manual operations overhead.
Led frontend development for a global e-commerce app using React and GraphQL, serving 60M+ active users.
Optimized a Node.js/Express BFF layer, streamlining integration across 20+ microservices for higher scalability.
Architected a country configuration system, enabling rapid international localization and multi-brand expansion.
Integrated Google Wallet with 3DS across 26 countries, driving a 10% conversion lift in checkout flows.
Executed A/B testing on cart recommendations via Firebase, boosting CTA engagement and productizing top variants.
Engineered a drag-and-drop PWA Email Builder from scratch with React and PostgreSQL for marketing teams.
Developed a viral referral feature that expanded the global user base by 800K+ customers across major markets.
Architected a React/GraphQL POC to standardize microservice API call mapping and error diagnostics.
Mentored junior engineers on frontend architecture and best practices to accelerate onboarding and team output.

openSource.title: Twenty
openSource.subtitle: (YCombinator - S23)
contributions: Engineered core CRM features for Twenty using NX, Recoil, and GraphQL to provide a modern open-source alternative to Salesforce.
Collaborated with core maintainers to identify and resolve performance bottlenecks within the Docker-orchestrated environment.

projects.name: Wizard's Chess (PWA)
projects.description: A high-performance multiplayer 3D chess environment with real-time social features.
details: Implemented immersive 3D rendering and game state management using React Three Fiber and Three.js.
Integrated peer-to-peer video communication using WebRTC and Firebase for real-time multiplayer engagement.
